faq.title: Your Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our transport services for construction sites. From material delivery to waste management, we're here to help you understand our services better.

features.title: Timely Delivery
features.description: We understand that every delivery impacts your project timeline. Our commitment to timely delivery ensures your construction projects stay on schedule.

features.title: Eco-Friendly Practices
features.description: We prioritize environmental responsibility in all our operations. Our eco-friendly practices ensure sustainable transport solutions for your construction needs.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Al-Barq provides reliable transport services across Tabuk and NEOM regions. We specialize in construction site transport and are known for timely delivery and quality service in these areas.

faqs.question: What materials do you transport?
faqs.answer: We transport a wide range of construction materials including sand, aggregate, stone, sub-base, and soil. We also provide drinking water supply and handle waste water removal for construction sites.

faqs.question: Do you provide heavy equipment transport services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer specialized lowbed and flatbed transport services for heavy machinery and oversized equipment. We safely transport construction equipment to and from sites with our professional fleet.

faqs.question: How quickly can you deliver materials?
faqs.answer: We prioritize timely delivery to keep your construction projects on schedule. Delivery times depend on the material type, quantity, and location. Contact us for specific delivery timelines for your project needs.

faqs.question: Do you offer equipment rental services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide reliable heavy equipment rental services for construction projects. We offer well-maintained construction machinery and equipment with flexible rental terms to meet your project requirements.

items.title: Inside Saudi Arabia's construction surge: three key takeaways
items.description: As a shorthand, everything you need to know about the Saudi Arabian construction industry can be gleaned from the drive from the airport to the capital, Riyadh. Along the route – a distance of around 35km (21 miles) – even the most unobservant of people will be struck by the sheer amount of construction work taking place.
